slides.title: Paper A
slides.full_title: Paper A: Occlusion-Aware Hand Pose Estimation with Temporal Priors
slides.problem: Hand pose breaks when fingers are occluded
slides.approach: Carries the previous pose forward as a prior
novelty: Temporal prior gated by joint visibility
limitations: Tested on one camera setup only
slides.takeaway: A cheap fix for short occlusions, not long ones
notes: Spoken: the prior is the previous pose, trusted less when a joint is hidden.
Spoken: the long-occlusion drift is the gap our fusion work targets.

slides.title: Paper B
slides.full_title: Paper B: Fusing EMG and Vision for Robust Hand Tracking
slides.problem: Vision-only tracking fails under heavy occlusion
slides.approach: Fuses wearable EMG features with image features

methods.takeaway: Methods differ mainly in the extra signal they bring

results.takeaway: Extra sensing helps most when fingers are hidden
results.note: Synthetic numbers for this example; occluded subset of a shared benchmark
